title: Contextual formulaic-language revision corpus
purpose: Surface contextual remove, rewrite, and review signals in prose. This corpus is not an authorship detector and cannot establish whether a person or system wrote a passage.

patterns.explanation: Repeated invitation language can add ceremony without clarifying the action.
patterns.revision_move: Name the subject and action directly, or keep one use when it is the writer's natural voice.
exceptions: A literal discussion of research exploration
positive_examples: This chapter delves into the trade-offs behind the migration.
counterexamples: The chapter compares migration trade-offs.

patterns.explanation: A concentration of elevated modifiers can conceal a missing concrete claim.
patterns.revision_move: Replace only the vague occurrence with a fact, consequence, or ordinary precise word.
positive_examples: The pivotal, multifaceted framework enables a seamless experience.
counterexamples: The framework combines billing, permissions, and audit logs.

patterns.explanation: Ceremonial openings can delay the point of a guide or announcement.
patterns.revision_move: Open with the reader's task, decision, or consequence.
positive_examples: Join us on a journey through modern observability.
counterexamples: This guide shows how to trace a failed request.

patterns.explanation: The phrase compresses evidence, recurrence, and interpretation into an unshown authority claim.
patterns.revision_move: Name the observed cases and the inference, or remove the frame.
exceptions: The pattern is then demonstrated with concrete examples
positive_examples: The pattern that keeps showing up is teams delaying ownership decisions.
counterexamples: In three incident reviews, ownership was assigned after the outage began.

patterns.explanation: The compact verdict can hide which population, condition, or decision is out of scope.
patterns.revision_move: Specify the boundary and what it prevents the reader from concluding.
exceptions: A heading followed immediately by scope details
positive_examples: The limitation is scope.
counterexamples: The study covers paid accounts in New Zealand, so it cannot estimate free-user retention.

patterns.explanation: The frame can create unearned intimacy or authority when the criteria never follow.
patterns.revision_move: Lead with the actual criteria; keep the first person only if experience is the evidence.
exceptions: A personal essay or operator note that provides a concrete decision process
positive_examples: Here’s how I actually decide whether to adopt a tool.
counterexamples: I adopt a tool when it removes a repeated manual step, works offline, and has an export path.

patterns.explanation: A verdict about a default, approach, or model can substitute for explaining the practical difference.
patterns.revision_move: Name both states and show what changes for the reader, organisation, or system.
exceptions: A transition sentence followed by a concrete comparison
positive_examples: That’s a fundamentally different approach.
counterexamples: The old policy required annual reviews; the new policy requires one each quarter.

patterns.explanation: A service-chat sign-off can remain after text is repurposed as a document.
patterns.revision_move: Delete it, or replace it with the reader's next concrete step.
exceptions: A real support reply where a warm closing is appropriate
positive_examples: I hope this helps!
counterexamples: Run `tool verify` after updating the configuration.

patterns.explanation: An open-ended service offer can leave a published piece without a useful ending.
patterns.revision_move: End with an owner, decision, or specific contact path when one is needed.
exceptions: A direct message or customer-support response
positive_examples: Let me know if you have any questions.
counterexamples: For account access, contact support@example.com with the workspace ID.

patterns.explanation: The sentence announces importance instead of demonstrating it.
patterns.revision_move: State the fact and its consequence directly.
exceptions: A safety warning with a specific consequence immediately following
positive_examples: It is worth noting that backups matter.
It is crucial to note that backups matter.
counterexamples: Backups are encrypted but cannot restore deleted workspace keys.

patterns.explanation: Ceremonial evaluation can replace the observable result.
patterns.revision_move: Describe the result and who benefited instead.
positive_examples: The launch serves as a testament to our commitment.
counterexamples: The launch cut onboarding from three days to one.

patterns.explanation: Stock headings can be useful, but repeated template structure may not fit the piece.
patterns.revision_move: Use a heading that names the actual decision, result, or next action.
exceptions: A house style that requires this heading
positive_examples: ## Key Takeaways
counterexamples: ## What changes for existing accounts

patterns.explanation: Several consecutive sentences with the same opener can flatten motion.
patterns.revision_move: Vary only the redundant openings while preserving useful parallelism.
positive_examples: This changes access. This changes billing. This changes reporting.
counterexamples: Access changes immediately. Billing changes at renewal. Reports refresh overnight.

patterns.explanation: A long run of very short sentences can feel mechanically clipped outside instructions or deliberate emphasis.
patterns.revision_move: Combine related ideas where that improves the thought's rhythm.
positive_examples: It failed. We waited. It failed again. We stopped.
counterexamples: It failed twice, so we stopped the rollout and preserved the logs.

patterns.explanation: A dense run of em dashes can obscure sentence relationships. An em dash is not a banned mark.
patterns.revision_move: Keep dashes that carry a real interruption; recast only repeated parenthetical uses.
positive_examples: The queue—already delayed—stalled again—then recovered—without an alert.
counterexamples: The queue, already delayed, stalled again and then recovered without an alert.

patterns.explanation: A concentration of exclamation points can flatten emphasis.
patterns.revision_move: Reserve the mark for the few places where it changes the intended voice.
positive_examples: It shipped! It works! Try it now! Tell everyone!
counterexamples: It shipped. Start with the migration guide.

patterns.explanation: Repeated uses can announce significance instead of providing the supporting detail.
patterns.revision_move: Keep a necessary use, but replace the others with the fact or consequence being emphasised.
exceptions: A contrast that needs explicit emphasis
positive_examples: This underscores the pivotal nature of the change.
counterexamples: The change prevents archived accounts from signing in.

patterns.explanation: In informational prose, repeated promotional framing can obscure what is actually demonstrated.
patterns.revision_move: Name the demonstration, result, or capability directly.
positive_examples: The dashboard showcases our robust reporting.
counterexamples: The dashboard compares weekly revenue by region.

patterns.explanation: Abstract domain nouns can make a familiar setting sound grander and less specific.
patterns.revision_move: Name the relevant market, system, place, or audience when that improves precision.
exceptions: A domain term defined by the field
positive_examples: In today's landscape, the data realm forms a rich tapestry.
counterexamples: For small retailers, the change affects checkout and inventory sync.

patterns.explanation: These ordinary terms become vague when several stand in for a mechanism, constraint, or result.
patterns.revision_move: Retain technical meanings, but replace unsupported praise with a testable property or action.
exceptions: A precise domain definition of leverage
positive_examples: Leverage the robust platform for a seamless workflow.
counterexamples: Use the retry queue to resume interrupted imports without duplicating records.

patterns.explanation: The preamble asks for weight before identifying the relevant effect.
patterns.revision_move: State the effect and its stakes without an importance announcement.
exceptions: A formal research discussion immediately followed by a specific result
positive_examples: This highlights the importance of collaboration.
counterexamples: The handoff failed because no team owned the customer record.

patterns.explanation: Repeated reveal-by-negation frames can make each point arrive as a staged discovery.
patterns.revision_move: Lead with the supported claim and retain the comparison only when it changes the decision.
exceptions: A genuine correction of a likely misconception
positive_examples: It is not just a tool, but a fundamentally different default.
counterexamples: The tool changes who must approve access requests.

patterns.explanation: The correction template can overstate a choice that may have legitimate alternatives.
patterns.revision_move: Name the condition under which the recommended option is preferable.
exceptions: A safety instruction with a true substitute
A direct answer to an explicit misconception
positive_examples: You don't need more features; you need better strategy.
counterexamples: If approval is the bottleneck, assign a single reviewer before adding automation.

patterns.explanation: A repeated rhetorical-question pivot can make an argument sound like a slide presentation.
patterns.revision_move: Use the question when the reader truly needs it; otherwise state the answer as a continuation of the argument.
positive_examples: So what? The answer is a better default.
counterexamples: The new default retries only idempotent requests.

patterns.explanation: Repeated pre-announced analogies can over-teach or postpone the concrete explanation.
patterns.revision_move: Explain the mechanism first; retain one analogy only if it resolves a real confusion.
exceptions: Educational material for a new audience
A difficult abstraction that benefits from analogy
positive_examples: Imagine a cache as a librarian who remembers every request.
counterexamples: The cache stores recent responses so the service avoids repeated database reads.

patterns.explanation: Stage directions can remain after a conversational explanation becomes finished prose.
patterns.revision_move: Move directly to the detail that earns the reader's attention.
positive_examples: Here's the interesting part: the queue heals itself.
counterexamples: The queue renews its lease every 30 seconds and marks abandoned work stale.

patterns.explanation: A stock opening can spend the first sentence on atmosphere rather than the actual situation.
patterns.revision_move: Open with the decision, change, reader, or concrete constraint.
exceptions: A broad trend piece that immediately defines the change
positive_examples: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, adaptability is key.
counterexamples: New import rules take effect on 1 August for sellers using third-party fulfilment.

patterns.explanation: A generic closer can repeat the document's job instead of completing it.
patterns.revision_move: End with the decision, unresolved constraint, or next action that the piece has earned.
exceptions: A template that mandates a conclusion label
positive_examples: In conclusion, the future is bright.
counterexamples: Approve the migration only after the restore test passes.

patterns.explanation: Generic praise can survive when a chat answer is repurposed as a document.
patterns.revision_move: Remove the service wrapper and begin with the answer or a specific acknowledgement.
exceptions: A personal note where praise is sincere and specific
positive_examples: Great question! This is a nuanced topic.
counterexamples: The option controls whether failed uploads are retried.

patterns.explanation: An assistant-like offer can dilute a document ending when no response is possible.
patterns.revision_move: Replace it with a concrete support route or remove it.
exceptions: A help centre article with a real contact option
positive_examples: I can also help if you need anything else.
counterexamples: Open a support ticket and include the workspace identifier.

patterns.explanation: Unnamed authority makes a claim hard to assess or verify.
patterns.revision_move: Name the source, scope the claim, or state it as the writer's judgement.
exceptions: A deliberate summary that links to named sources nearby
positive_examples: Industry leaders agree that this approach works.
counterexamples: In the 2025 survey of 312 operators, 61% reported using a weekly review.

patterns.explanation: Abstract benefit claims can fit almost any product or team.
patterns.revision_move: Name the user, mechanism, and measured or observable result.
exceptions: A campaign slogan that is intentionally broad
positive_examples: Unlock the full potential of your data.
counterexamples: Export daily orders to the warehouse without a custom integration.

patterns.explanation: Escalated praise can make a modest claim feel generic or untrustworthy.
patterns.revision_move: Replace the verdict with the changed capability, baseline, or constraint.
positive_examples: This game-changing platform is transformative.
counterexamples: The platform removes the manual CSV export from the nightly process.

patterns.explanation: Formulaic enthusiasm can consume space that should show fit and evidence.
patterns.revision_move: Name the relevant work, constraint, or result that connects the writer to the role.
exceptions: A personal message with specific accompanying detail
positive_examples: I am thrilled to apply to your innovative organisation.
counterexamples: I led the accessibility audit that reduced support requests for keyboard navigation.

patterns.explanation: A repeated label-and-colon list can be useful, but may turn a connected argument into a template.
patterns.revision_move: Keep labels for scanability; merge items or write prose where relationships matter.
exceptions: A comparison table rendered as bullets
positive_examples:
- **Speed:** Fast.
- **Scale:** Large.
- **Value:** High.
counterexamples: The cache reduces repeated reads, but it also needs an eviction policy.

patterns.explanation: Repeated decorative markers can substitute for hierarchy or logical transitions.
patterns.revision_move: Use headings, verbs, and sentence relationships where they carry more meaning.
exceptions: A checklist where icons convey state
positive_examples: ✨ Plan → Build → Launch 🚀
counterexamples: Plan the migration, test the restore path, then schedule the cutover.

patterns.explanation: Repeated three-part cadence can make unrelated points sound manufactured into the same shape.
patterns.revision_move: Keep the triad that improves recall; vary other sentence structures to match the reasoning.
positive_examples: It is faster, safer, and easier.
counterexamples: It removes a manual step and adds an audit record.

patterns.explanation: A steady run of questions can create suspense without moving the explanation forward.
patterns.revision_move: Keep questions that genuinely organise inquiry; convert rhetorical questions into claims.
positive_examples: Why now? Why this team? Why this tool? Why wait?
counterexamples: The team chose the tool because it supports offline review.

patterns.explanation: Repeated semicolons can signal a fixed sentence rhythm rather than necessary close coordination.
patterns.revision_move: Keep semicolons that clarify the relation; split or join the rest by meaning.
positive_examples: It queued; it retried; it logged; it completed.
counterexamples: It queued the work, retried once, and logged the final result.

patterns.explanation: Repeated self-translation can restate an already clear point instead of adding evidence.
patterns.revision_move: Keep the clarification where the first phrasing is technical; delete duplicate paraphrases.
exceptions: A definition followed by a plain-language translation
positive_examples: In other words, it is a different default. Put simply, the choice changed.
counterexamples: The client now retries only idempotent requests.

patterns.explanation: Repeated conclusion labels can report the argument instead of advancing it.
patterns.revision_move: Let the paragraph's claim do the work, or use one summary at a genuine decision point.
exceptions: A long report with explicit decision checkpoints
positive_examples: The key takeaway is that this matters. The bottom line is to act.
counterexamples: Approve the change only if the owner accepts the recovery plan.

patterns.explanation: Distributed hedges can make an otherwise supported claim sound uniformly tentative.
patterns.revision_move: Attach uncertainty to the precise unknown and state supported conclusions plainly.
exceptions: Scientific writing with genuinely uncertain evidence
positive_examples: It may perhaps generally be somewhat useful.
counterexamples: The estimate may change if late invoices arrive.

patterns.explanation: Repeated boosters can pre-argue for a conclusion instead of showing why it follows.
patterns.revision_move: Replace the intensifier with evidence, comparison, or a bounded claim.
exceptions: A true logical conclusion already demonstrated
positive_examples: Clearly, this is obviously and fundamentally the right choice.
counterexamples: The new policy removes the exception that caused duplicate payments.

patterns.explanation: Repeatedly naming a pattern can package an observation before its boundaries are clear.
patterns.revision_move: Define the mechanism, cases, and limits before retaining a useful label.
exceptions: A paper introducing and defining its own term
positive_examples: This Momentum Principle changes everything.
counterexamples: Teams moved faster after they assigned one owner to each approval.

patterns.explanation: A repeated confession-and-reveal arc can feel staged when it lacks specific experience.
patterns.revision_move: Keep the reversal when it records a real change; add the event or evidence that changed the view.
exceptions: A personal essay built around genuine reflection
positive_examples: I used to think speed mattered. Then I realised trust mattered more.
counterexamples: After the failed launch, I changed the rollout checklist to require an owner for each rollback step.

patterns.explanation: A generic optimism reset can flatten the real trade-offs or leave a conclusion unearned.
patterns.revision_move: End with the actual opportunity, risk, or next action supported by the piece.
exceptions: A speech or campaign intentionally designed for uplift
positive_examples: The future is bright, and the possibilities are endless.
counterexamples: The pilot can expand after the team documents the rollback procedure.

patterns.explanation: A stated moral can explain a story after its concrete consequence has already done the work.
patterns.revision_move: Keep the moral only where the reader needs the inference; otherwise end on the consequence or decision.
exceptions: A retrospective with an explicit lessons section
positive_examples: The lesson is simple: always be adaptable.
counterexamples: We now test restores before declaring a migration complete.

patterns.explanation: Repeated tidy chronology can impose a lesson-shaped sequence on events that have more useful friction or overlap.
patterns.revision_move: Keep ordered steps for a real procedure; otherwise use the causal or temporal order that explains what changed.
positive_examples: First we planned, then we acted, and finally we succeeded.
counterexamples: The incident began during the deploy; the missing alert delayed diagnosis until the next morning.

patterns.explanation: A bridging verb can hide what is missing, between which things, and what changes when the absence is repaired.
patterns.revision_move: Name both endpoints, the missing evidence or capability, the affected actor, and the concrete intervention; delete the claim if the source supplies none.
exceptions: A measured gap whose endpoints and unit are stated
A literal or source-supported use that names both endpoints, the mechanism, and the affected actor
positive_examples: The platform bridges the gap between strategy and execution.
counterexamples: The pay gap narrowed from 12% to 8%.
A footbridge spans the 1.2-metre gap between the platforms.

patterns.explanation: A ceremonial shift frame grants importance without stating the old state, new state, actor, or date.
patterns.revision_move: State what was true before, what is true now, who changed it, when, and the practical consequence.
exceptions: A sourced historical realignment with a documented before and after
positive_examples: The policy marks a significant shift in how councils regulate rentals.
counterexamples: From July, councils rather than landlords will inspect rentals before tenants move in.

patterns.explanation: A labelled shift can magnify a change before its reach or duration is established.
patterns.revision_move: Replace the label with the changed rule, behaviour, distribution, or decision and its bounded evidence.
exceptions: An established technical or historical term used with supporting evidence
positive_examples: The launch created a paradigm shift in customer engagement.
counterexamples: Customers can now reply to an order update without opening the app.

patterns.explanation: Role language assigns importance while weakening the action or causal claim.
patterns.revision_move: Name what the actor does, what would fail without it, or the measured contribution; qualify multifactor causation locally.
exceptions: A causal analysis that cannot isolate one factor
positive_examples: Trust plays a pivotal role in completion.
counterexamples: Naming the sender raised completion from 42% to 61%.

patterns.explanation: The frame asserts unlimited importance instead of showing a consequence.
patterns.revision_move: Lead with the warning, threshold, evidence, or decision that makes the point important.
positive_examples: The importance of access control cannot be overstated.
counterexamples: Without access control, any signed-in user can export the account list.

patterns.explanation: A symbolic frame can turn an event into a generic lesson the source never makes.
patterns.revision_move: State the event and evidence; name whose interpretation it is if symbolic meaning matters.
positive_examples: The recovery serves as a powerful reminder of the team’s resilience.
counterexamples: The team restored checkout in 47 minutes and cleared the backlog before noon.

patterns.explanation: A pathway metaphor compresses an uncertain causal sequence into a familiar historical story.
patterns.revision_move: Name the prerequisite created, the later decision, and the evidence connecting them; distinguish an enabling condition from a cause.
positive_examples: The agreement paves the way for lasting reform.
counterexamples: The agreement lets the regulator inspect records without a new court order.

patterns.explanation: A discovery metaphor can replace the actual finding or comparison.
patterns.revision_move: State what the evidence shows, what was previously unknown, and how the conclusion follows.
positive_examples: The survey sheds new light on rural access.
counterexamples: The survey includes 84 rural clinics that earlier studies excluded.

patterns.explanation: The frame enlarges one observation by attaching it to an unnamed pattern.
patterns.revision_move: Name comparable cases, a time series, or the source that identifies the trend; otherwise limit the claim to the observed case.
exceptions: A sourced trend with several comparable cases
positive_examples: The decision reflects a broader shift towards transparency.
counterexamples: Four councils began publishing inspection outcomes after the 2025 rule change.

patterns.explanation: Durability and importance are asserted without tracing later adoption or effect.
patterns.revision_move: Name the later users, rule, institution, behaviour, or dated evidence that continues.
exceptions: A bounded influence claim supported by adoption, citations, or law
positive_examples: The programme left a lasting impact on the community.
counterexamples: The council still funds the clinic under the programme created in 2019.

patterns.explanation: A depth marker announces the primary explanation before proving that it outranks alternatives.
patterns.revision_move: State the proposed cause or governing constraint and show the evidence that gives it priority.
exceptions: Anatomy, graph theory, or formal root-cause analysis
positive_examples: At its core, the issue is trust.
counterexamples: Respondents who could identify the sender completed the form more often.

patterns.explanation: The verdict frame packages a recommendation as a universal key.
patterns.revision_move: State the action, condition, or evidence and bound it to the actual setting.
exceptions: A clearly defined key factor in a ranked analysis
positive_examples: The key to success lies in strategic alignment.
counterexamples: Each launch has one owner who can approve or stop the release.

patterns.explanation: A staged pivot manufactures suspense around information the writer can state directly.
patterns.revision_move: Delete the cue and lead with the answer, exception, or consequence.
positive_examples: Here’s the catch: the export omits archived records.
counterexamples: The export omits archived records.

patterns.explanation: The frame invents a rejected premise so the real claim can arrive as a reveal.
patterns.revision_move: State the positive claim first; keep the contrast only when both interpretations are genuinely in play.
exceptions: Deliberate rhetoric in a speech or essay
positive_examples: This isn’t about speed; it’s about confidence.
counterexamples: Delay the cutover until security validates the vendor.

patterns.explanation: The phrase inflates a noun by implying an unnamed, lesser interpretation.
patterns.revision_move: Name the additional function or consequence directly, or remove the comparison.
exceptions: A necessary distinction whose two sides are both specified
positive_examples: The queue is more than just a tracking tool.
counterexamples: The queue records approvals and shows which team has not responded.

patterns.explanation: An agency verb promises a benefit without naming the permission, removed obstacle, or new action.
patterns.revision_move: Say who can now do what and identify the feature, rule, or dependency that makes it possible.
exceptions: Legal authority, permissions, or accessibility language used precisely
positive_examples: The platform empowers teams to act with confidence.
counterexamples: Reviewers can approve the current build in the shared queue.

patterns.explanation: A cultivation metaphor claims culture change without identifying repeated management action or evidence.
patterns.revision_move: Name the practice, owner, incentive, duration, and observed behaviour.
exceptions: Foster care, agriculture, or literal cultivation
positive_examples: Weekly reviews foster a culture of accountability.
counterexamples: Each Friday, owners report missed deadlines and assign the next action.

patterns.explanation: Coping language makes the work sound active while leaving the obstacle or decision unnamed.
patterns.revision_move: Name the competing constraints, required decision, attempted action, and unresolved problem.
exceptions: An exact introductory summary followed immediately by specifics
positive_examples: Leaders must navigate the complexities of the evolving landscape.
counterexamples: Regulated teams need separate approvers and a seven-year audit log.

patterns.explanation: Strategic gloss replaces the tool, action, input, or output.
patterns.revision_move: Name the resource, who uses it, what they do with it, and the resulting decision or artefact.
positive_examples: Harness the power of data to unlock growth.
counterexamples: Analysts compare weekly cancellations by plan before changing renewal emails.

patterns.explanation: A movement verb often overstates causation while leaving the outcome unmeasured.
patterns.revision_move: State the causal mechanism, the observed rate or result, and whether the source supports cause or only association.
positive_examples: The initiative drives meaningful growth and innovation.
counterexamples: Renewals rose from 71% to 74% during the six-week pilot.

patterns.explanation: A friction-free claim hides the steps removed and the exceptions that remain.
patterns.revision_move: Describe the user action, handoff removed, supported systems, and remaining failure cases.
exceptions: A measured process with defined success criteria
positive_examples: The service seamlessly integrates with your workflow.
counterexamples: The connector imports approved tickets from Jira every five minutes.

patterns.explanation: Efficiency language hides which steps, waits, or handoffs changed.
patterns.revision_move: List the removed steps or give elapsed time before and after; name any remaining exception.
positive_examples: The queue streamlines the approval process.
counterexamples: The queue replaces three email threads and one tracking spreadsheet.

patterns.explanation: The phrase claims capacity without naming workload, environment, latency, cost, or failure limits.
patterns.revision_move: Define scale numerically and state the tested environment and result; otherwise remove the claim.
exceptions: A nearby numeric definition of scale
positive_examples: The service delivers proven results at scale.
counterexamples: The staging test processed 8,000 jobs in 14 minutes.

patterns.explanation: An abstract noun stack converts people and work into a management category.
patterns.revision_move: Recover the actors and verbs; separate the goal, method, and result.
exceptions: A defined management term required by the audience
positive_examples: The programme closes capability gaps and advances operational excellence.
counterexamples: Support staff will use one queue to assign and approve refund requests.

patterns.explanation: An insight label tells the reader information is useful without giving the finding or action.
patterns.revision_move: State the finding, measure, decision it supports, and responsible next action.
exceptions: Defined analytics terminology with operational criteria
positive_examples: The dashboard provides actionable insights.
counterexamples: The dashboard shows which invoices are more than 30 days overdue.

patterns.explanation: An assurance verb can turn design intent into a guarantee without test conditions.
patterns.revision_move: State the invariant, test, fallback, unsupported case, standard, and result the source actually establishes.
positive_examples: Retries ensure robust reliability at scale.
counterexamples: The client retries idempotent reads twice and returns the last provider error.

patterns.explanation: The phrase manufactures urgency without a dated trend, deadline, or consequence.
patterns.revision_move: Give the trend, deadline, changed rule, or cost of delay.
exceptions: A documented increase in risk or demand
positive_examples: Security is more important than ever.
counterexamples: The new rule takes effect on 1 September, and non-compliant accounts will be suspended.

patterns.explanation: A universal modernity preamble delays the specific event, problem, or decision.
patterns.revision_move: Delete it and begin with a dated change, reader problem, concrete scene, or thesis.
exceptions: Quotation, parody, or a deliberate speech opening
positive_examples: In an era where change is constant, agility is essential.
counterexamples: From 1 September, support staff will approve refunds in Nimbus.

patterns.explanation: A compulsory balance or future section can substitute for named risks and scheduled work.
patterns.revision_move: List the actual constraint, owner, status, and funded or scheduled next step; remove speculation.
exceptions: A report section containing documented risks and assigned work
positive_examples: The report concludes with challenges and future directions.
counterexamples: The team still lacks a rollback test; Priya will run one before Friday’s review.

patterns.explanation: The wrapper narrates delivery instead of delivering the artefact.
patterns.revision_move: Delete it and lead with the result or an informative heading; retain only a necessary scope note.
exceptions: A brief conversational orientation when the structure would otherwise surprise the reader
positive_examples: Here is your polished version.
counterexamples: Refund approval changes on 1 September.

patterns.explanation: Generic praise or agreement delays the answer and can sound ingratiating.
patterns.revision_move: Answer directly or acknowledge the specific correction and changed conclusion.
exceptions: A genuine acknowledgement where relationship is the task
positive_examples: Absolutely! Here is the answer.
counterexamples: The refund rule changes on 1 September.

patterns.explanation: Inherited email courtesy can bury the request, dependency, or deadline.
patterns.revision_move: Make the request directly, give the deadline and reason, and keep only relationship-specific warmth.
positive_examples: I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to reach out regarding the budget.
counterexamples: Could you approve the revised budget by Thursday?

patterns.explanation: A trend claim appears without a start date, adopter, comparison, or measure.
patterns.revision_move: Give the date and series, name who adopted the practice, or limit the sentence to the latest verified event.
positive_examples: Nimbus has emerged as a leading solution.
counterexamples: Twelve support teams adopted Nimbus between January and June 2026.

patterns.explanation: Repeated additive transitions can leave school-essay scaffolding after the relation is already clear.
patterns.revision_move: Combine evidence that supports one claim, begin with the new actor or fact, or start a new paragraph when the subject changes.
exceptions: Formal argument where cumulative support needs explicit signposting
positive_examples: Additionally, costs fell. Moreover, errors fell. Furthermore, delays fell.
counterexamples: Costs fell, and errors became less frequent.

patterns.explanation: Repeated participial tails compress agency, causation, and consequence into polished commentary.
patterns.revision_move: Name the actor in a finite clause, separate action from consequence, and qualify predicted effects.
exceptions: Simultaneous action with an unmistakable actor and relation
positive_examples: The queue records approvals, enabling transparency, highlighting delays.
counterexamples: The queue records approvals. Release owners can see which team has not responded.

patterns.explanation: Repeated substitutes for is or has can make plain description sound promotional or ceremonial.
patterns.revision_move: Use is or has when exact; otherwise name the function or user action that the verb genuinely adds.
positive_examples: It serves as a guide. It boasts a dashboard. It offers a toolkit.
counterexamples: The guide has a dashboard and three export formats.

patterns.explanation: An evaluative adverb tells the reader how to react before giving the comparison or consequence.
patterns.revision_move: State the surprising baseline, comparison, or consequence and let it establish importance.
exceptions: A stated comparison with an explicit expectation
positive_examples: Notably, completion improved.
counterexamples: Completion rose from 42% to 61% after the notice named the sender.

patterns.explanation: The passive status phrase implies progress while concealing owner, funding, action, and completion.
patterns.revision_move: Name the responsible actor, current action, start date, status, and next milestone.
exceptions: Sensitive reporting where details cannot be disclosed and that limit is stated
positive_examples: Efforts are underway to address the issue.
counterexamples: Facilities began replacing the damaged wiring on Tuesday.

patterns.explanation: An impersonal need frame hides who recommends the action and why.
patterns.revision_move: Name who should act, the failure or evidence prompting it, and any deadline or decision criterion.
positive_examples: There is a pressing need to improve communication.
counterexamples: Team leads should publish release decisions in the shared queue before 16:00.

patterns.explanation: A prestige modifier claims completeness or novelty before the contents and boundaries are clear.
patterns.revision_move: List components, inputs, outputs, included stages, and exclusions; call the thing what it concretely is.
exceptions: A scope that is explicitly exhaustive
positive_examples: A comprehensive framework supports a holistic approach.
counterexamples: The checklist covers intake, approval, deployment, and rollback.

patterns.explanation: A panoramic audience frame claims universal relevance without naming distinct needs.
patterns.revision_move: Name the actual audience and task; separate groups when their constraints differ.
positive_examples: From startups to enterprises, teams of all sizes can benefit.
counterexamples: Support teams handling more than 500 refunds a month can import requests in bulk.

patterns.explanation: A topic frame can delay the noun without naming a useful analytical dimension.
patterns.revision_move: Begin with the subject or measure; use a heading only when the passage genuinely changes dimension.
exceptions: A comparison that distinguishes several explicit dimensions
positive_examples: In terms of speed, it is faster. When it comes to cost, it is cheaper.
counterexamples: The new queue is faster but costs $40 more each month.

patterns.explanation: A vague demonstrative can hide the responsible action and overclaim its result.
patterns.revision_move: Repeat the exact action, name the beneficiary, and state the condition under which the result follows.
exceptions: An unambiguous reference to the immediately preceding action
positive_examples: This allows better work. By doing so, teams improve.
counterexamples: Publishing the owner beside each request lets support route overdue work.

patterns.explanation: An atmospheric transition can substitute for the event or rule that changes the next claim.
patterns.revision_move: Name the event, date, rule, or evidence that makes the context relevant.
exceptions: Historical or legal context that materially changes interpretation
positive_examples: Against this backdrop, change is needed. In this context, teams must adapt.
counterexamples: The new rule takes effect on 1 September, so support needs an approval queue before then.

patterns.explanation: Repeated vague quantity suggests breadth without committing to scope.
patterns.revision_move: Give the count, list representative items with a selection reason, or state the bounded scope.
exceptions: A non-exhaustive set where enumeration would distract
positive_examples: Various teams use numerous tools across a wide range of workflows.
counterexamples: Four support teams use Jira, Zendesk, and Linear.

patterns.explanation: A dense run of model-associated prestige or atmospheric words can make prose sound selected from a common palette.
patterns.revision_move: Inspect each occurrence for exact meaning; keep precise terms and replace ornamental ones with actors, evidence, or concrete description.
positive_examples: The vibrant study unveils groundbreaking advancements, fostering a palpable interplay.
counterexamples: The study compares four treatments and reports the adverse events for each.

patterns.explanation: An infomercial-style hook tells the reader to expect a reveal or react before the prose has earned the emphasis.
patterns.revision_move: Delete the cue and state the fact, exception, consequence, or comparison directly.
exceptions: A spoken performance or deliberate social voice
Quotation, parody, or a writer-owned refrain
positive_examples: But make no mistake: this changes everything. Let that sink in.
counterexamples: The second charge is pending, and the bank may take three to five business days to release it.

patterns.explanation: Meta-narration announces the explanation instead of beginning it.
patterns.revision_move: Open with the subject, answer, claim, or an informative heading.
exceptions: A teaching plan whose sequence must be previewed
A speech transition suited to the speaker
positive_examples: In this article, we will explore the issue. Without further ado, let's take a closer look.
counterexamples: The audit compared 14 invoices issued between January and March.

patterns.explanation: A model-limit disclaimer has leaked into prose instead of naming the actual source boundary.
patterns.revision_move: State which sources and dates were checked, identify the missing record, or remove the irrelevant disclaimer.
exceptions: A dated report on a search process
positive_examples: As of my knowledge cutoff, specific details are limited based on available information.
counterexamples: The register covers applications filed through 30 June 2026; later records were not available for this review.

patterns.explanation: A stock empathy sequence can sound detached when it precedes the specific event, remedy, or limit.
patterns.revision_move: Acknowledge the exact problem in the recipient's terms, then explain the remedy, owner, timing, and limits.
exceptions: A sincere support response in the organisation's established voice
Care, counselling, crisis, or relationship contexts
positive_examples: Thank you for reaching out. We completely understand how frustrating this must be. Rest assured that we're committed to making this right.
counterexamples: You were charged twice. The second charge is pending, and Mina will check it again on 22 July.

patterns.explanation: Blanket validation can convert empathy into agreement with facts or inferences that have not been established.
patterns.revision_move: Acknowledge the specific concern, separate feeling from contested fact, and state what can and cannot be concluded.
exceptions: Genuine emotional support where the conclusion is warranted
positive_examples: You're not overreacting. Your instincts are right, and you did nothing wrong.
counterexamples: Your concern is understandable; the available record confirms the duplicate charge but not its cause.

patterns.explanation: A stock purpose frame delays the research question and method.
patterns.revision_move: State the population, comparison, variable, corpus, method, or research question directly.
exceptions: A required abstract structure or protocol field
A house style that mandates an aim statement
positive_examples: This study aims to explore appointment delays.
counterexamples: The study compared appointment records for 312 adults referred through two routes.

patterns.explanation: An understanding claim labels the contribution without stating what distinction or result became clearer.
patterns.revision_move: Name the finding, distinction, mechanism, boundary, or decision the work supports.
exceptions: A bounded synthesis that immediately names what is now understood
positive_examples: The study contributes to our understanding and provides a deeper understanding of access.
counterexamples: The records show an eight-day median difference between the two referral routes.

patterns.explanation: A generic future-work line claims an agenda without naming the unresolved question or next design.
patterns.revision_move: Name the missing population, variable, comparison, method, or experiment; otherwise delete the line.
exceptions: A limitations section proposing a specific next study
A grant or protocol with defined future work
positive_examples: Further research is needed to fully understand the issue and open new avenues.
counterexamples: A multi-site study should test whether the eight-day difference persists after accounting for transport and cancellations.

patterns.explanation: An undated literature-growth claim borrows scale without a review, period, count, or named debate.
patterns.revision_move: Cite the review, date range, publication count, or specific debate, or remove the trend claim.
exceptions: A literature review that immediately defines the corpus
positive_examples: A growing body of literature has garnered significant scholarly attention.
counterexamples: The review includes 43 trials published between 2018 and 2025.

patterns.explanation: A generic research attribution asks the reader to accept evidence that has not been named or bounded.
patterns.revision_move: Name and cite the study or review, state the sample and result, or own the claim as analysis.
exceptions: A citation immediately identifies the source
A summary whose source set is explicitly defined
positive_examples: Research shows that the programme improves outcomes.
counterexamples: In the 2025 trial of 312 adults, median waiting time fell by eight days.

patterns.explanation: An obviousness frame supplies certainty or importance before the evidence or question is visible.
patterns.revision_move: State the evidence, question, consequence, or calibrated degree of confidence.
exceptions: A quotation or required legal formula
positive_examples: It is clear that this raises important questions. There is no doubt that action is needed.
counterexamples: The records omit cancellation data, so they cannot explain the eight-day difference.

patterns.explanation: A prestige label implies a benchmark, environment, workload, or standard without naming it.
patterns.revision_move: Cite the benchmark or standard and state the environment, version, load, gate, or supported boundary.
exceptions: A sourced benchmark or named standard
An official product tier or required term
positive_examples: The world-class, state-of-the-art platform is production-ready and future-proof.
counterexamples: The service passed the production gate at 8,000 jobs per minute with p95 latency below 120 ms.

patterns.explanation: Ceremonial virtue language awards character without showing the repeated action, duration, cost, or result.
patterns.revision_move: Name the concrete commitment, responsible actor, repeated practice, deadline, investment, or measured result.
exceptions: Attributed ceremonial, obituary, or speech language
positive_examples: The launch reflects our unwavering commitment to excellence and tireless dedication to innovation.
counterexamples: The council funded two weekly clinics through June 2027.

patterns.explanation: A dense run of formal substitutes can make ordinary action sound administrative or ceremonious.
patterns.revision_move: Keep the exact term where needed; elsewhere use the clearest ordinary verb or name the action more precisely.
positive_examples: The team will utilise the toolkit, facilitate adoption, and commence work to ascertain the outcome.
counterexamples: The team will use the checklist, start on Monday, and measure completion after four weeks.

patterns.explanation: Several topic containers in one paragraph can blur participants, relationships, stages, and actual changes.
patterns.revision_move: Keep exact terms; otherwise name the organisations, factors, criterion, sequence, dependency, or disputed proposition.
exceptions: Biology, optics, mathematics, narratology, or another exact domain
positive_examples: Through a new lens, the ecosystem journey sits at the intersection of several evolving dynamics.
counterexamples: The regulator changed the filing rule, and three banks altered their review process.

patterns.explanation: Stock travel-copy atmosphere can describe almost any place while withholding location, scene, or evidence.
patterns.revision_move: Give the location, terrain, street, institution, event, population, or observed activity that creates the impression.
positive_examples: Nestled in the heart of the valley, the bustling town is a vibrant hub and hidden gem.
counterexamples: The town sits 12 kilometres north of the pass and hosts a produce market every Saturday.

patterns.explanation: Generic heritage and audience language praises breadth without identifying the history, people, or activity.
patterns.revision_move: Give the date, origin, conflict, founder, trade, named group, season, or access condition.
exceptions: A campaign deliberately using a familiar slogan
positive_examples: The town boasts a rich history and offers something for locals and visitors alike.
counterexamples: Tin miners founded the settlement in 1874; the restored assay office opens on weekends.

patterns.explanation: Consequence theatre assigns historical reach before tracing an affected group, later event, or time horizon.
patterns.revision_move: Name the changed rule, later adoption, affected group, measurable consequence, and date; otherwise keep the claim local.
positive_examples: The launch ushers in a new era with far-reaching implications and opens a new chapter for the industry.
counterexamples: From July, the rule moves refund approval from support to finance.

patterns.explanation: An emotion or resonance label can announce the response instead of letting observation and voice create it.
patterns.revision_move: Show the observation and name who responded; retain the emotion only when the writer owns it and the detail earns it.
exceptions: Personal writing in the author's established voice
positive_examples: What surprised me most was how the story resonates deeply and captures the essence of change.
counterexamples: I stopped at the third letter because it used the same sentence my father wrote in 1998.

patterns.explanation: A packaged growth line turns a particular experience into a tidy universal moral.
patterns.revision_move: Show the decision, scene, or later behaviour and preserve any unresolved or partial change.
exceptions: A lesson the writer explicitly endorses in their own voice
Parable, children's instruction, or intentionally didactic prose
positive_examples: The setback taught me a valuable lesson, and I emerged stronger in a full-circle moment.
counterexamples: After the failed launch, I began testing restores before each migration.

patterns.explanation: A cluster of sentimental or atmospheric terms may supply mood without an observed scene or owned voice.
patterns.revision_move: Identify the person, action, sound, object, or sensory detail creating the mood; preserve deliberate literary language.
exceptions: Fiction, poetry, quotation, or reported sensory detail
positive_examples: An unspoken camaraderie offered fleeting solace amid the palpable cacophony.
counterexamples: The chairs scraped across the floor while Mara folded the letter into her coat pocket.

patterns.explanation: A stock concession can simulate balance while leaving both the success and the constraint vague.
patterns.revision_move: Name the measured success and actual constraint, compare like with like, or choose the supported claim.
exceptions: A genuine concession with specific evidence on both sides
positive_examples: While the programme is impressive, adoption remains a challenge.
counterexamples: Completion rose from 42% to 61%, but the pilot excluded accounts with more than 500 users.

patterns.explanation: A future-narrative closer sounds predictive without naming a falsifiable event, measure, or date.
patterns.revision_move: Give the bounded forecast, condition, measure, and date, or end at the last supported claim.
exceptions: A sourced forecast with a stated test
positive_examples: This may become one of the most important narratives of the coming decade.
counterexamples: The forecast expects annual demand to exceed 40,000 units by 2028 if the subsidy remains in force.

patterns.explanation: A generic endorsement tells the reader something is valuable without giving a reason suited to them.
patterns.revision_move: State what the resource contains, who it helps, and why that detail matters; otherwise drop the endorsement.
exceptions: A personal recommendation whose reason is already clear
positive_examples: This one is worth your time and a must-read you won't want to miss.
counterexamples: The report compares six retry strategies and includes the raw latency data for each.

patterns.explanation: A sequence of negated fragments can manufacture suspense before a simple positive claim.
patterns.revision_move: State the supported positive proposition once; retain the countdown only when deliberate rhetoric earns it.
exceptions: Deliberate speech, fiction, or campaign rhetoric
A contrast in which every rejected option matters
positive_examples: No tricks. No shortcuts. Just results.
counterexamples: The report excludes price and speed; it measures trust.

patterns.explanation: A candour frame can announce truthfulness or certainty instead of earning it from evidence and voice.
patterns.revision_move: State the fact, judgement, or disagreement directly and give its basis.
exceptions: Dialogue or a writer's established conversational voice
A genuine contrast with an earlier misconception
positive_examples: Let's be clear: the truth is that this changes everything.
counterexamples: The permit expires on 31 August, so work must stop the next day.

patterns.explanation: Two uncertainty markers can cancel the commitment without defining what is unknown.
patterns.revision_move: Choose the uncertainty the evidence warrants and name the condition, likelihood, or time horizon.
exceptions: A technical distinction in which the markers express separate uncertainties
positive_examples: The change could potentially improve retention and may eventually reduce costs.
counterexamples: Retention may improve if the reminder reaches inactive accounts.

patterns.explanation: A universal-audience frame can avoid choosing whose needs and constraints the prose actually serves.
patterns.revision_move: Name the primary reader, or distinguish the actions and information each audience needs.
exceptions: The material genuinely supplies different paths for the named audiences
A sourced accessibility or eligibility statement
positive_examples: Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned professional, there is something for everyone.
counterexamples: New administrators should start with account setup; experienced operators can go directly to migration.

patterns.explanation: A stock engagement closer asks for a reaction before giving a reader-specific reason.
patterns.revision_move: State what the resource contains, who it helps, and why; omit the prompt if no practical reason exists.
exceptions: A channel where saving or bookmarking is a real procedural step
positive_examples: Save this for later, and thank me later.
counterexamples: Save the permit PDF because the portal removes completed applications after 30 days.

patterns.explanation: Unnamed outside validation borrows credibility while withholding the evaluator, method, comparison, and date.
patterns.revision_move: Name and cite the evaluator, test, comparison, date, and result, or remove the claim.
exceptions: A citation immediately names the evaluator and test
A summary whose source set is explicitly defined
positive_examples: Independent testing confirms that we lead, and analysts agree.
counterexamples: In its April 2026 benchmark, Lab Q measured p95 latency at 118 ms.

patterns.explanation: A familiar filler idiom can delay the claim or restate its importance without adding content.
patterns.revision_move: Delete the frame and state the claim, qualification, or conclusion directly.
exceptions: Dialogue, quotation, parody, or a writer's established conversational voice
positive_examples: At the end of the day, the reality is that action is needed.
counterexamples: The licence expires on Friday, so the site must close on Saturday.

patterns.explanation: A stock hypothetical opening can make the desired outcome do the persuading before evidence appears.
patterns.revision_move: Begin with the real condition, evidence, reader problem, or bounded proposal.
exceptions: Fiction, speech, futures work, or a scenario that is explicitly analysed
positive_examples: Imagine a world where every team can unlock its potential.
counterexamples: The proposal would let rural clinics submit claims without a permanent connection.

patterns.explanation: An authenticity adjective can imply an unnamed fake alternative while leaving the claimed property untested.
patterns.revision_move: Name the contrasting case, measurement, mechanism, or result; otherwise remove the intensifier.
exceptions: The sentence names the contrasting false, simulated, or nominal case
A defined disciplinary distinction or quotation
positive_examples: The programme creates real impact and genuine value.
counterexamples: Fee revenue, rather than grants, funds the programme's monthly operating cost.
